memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks unaided around home, reports mild dyspnea on exertion.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), no immediate concern.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (within normal).
medicines: 9 regular (telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD, salbutamol MDI SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Denies low mood or anxiety, reports good sleep with melatonin.
carers: Daughter, Priya (primary caregiver).
goals: "I want to stay active and keep my kidney function stable."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.32 mg/dL (ref 0.57-1.00). eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m2 (ref >60). Urine albumin-creatinine ratio 85 mg/g (ref <30). Haemoglobin 12.4 g/dL (ref 12.0-15.5).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
telmisartan 40 mg OD
 dapagliflozin 10 mg OD
 furosemide 20 mg OD
 sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD
 salbutamol MDI SOS
 budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD
 montelukast 10 mg HS
 melatonin 3 mg HS
 trazodone 50 mg HS

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Penicillin – rash and pruritus after amoxicillin course 2 years ago. Avoid all beta-lactams.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 2.1 L (68% predicted), FVC 2.8 L (80% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.75. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 increase 12% (0.25 L), consistent with asthma showing reversible obstruction.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: "I’ve been waking up at 3 am feeling restless; melatonin isn’t helping as much lately. I’m also using my rescue inhaler more often, about twice a week."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent in ADLs, notes increased shortness of breath on climbing stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog repeated 4/5, stable.
falls: No new falls; gait slightly slower; timed up-and-go 12 seconds (borderline raised fall risk) – advise home exercise program and supportive footwear.
medicines: 9 regular – polypharmacy, Beers review due.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness.
carers: Daughter, Priya (primary caregiver).
goals: "I wish to breathe easier and keep my kidneys from worsening."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.38 mg/dL (ref 0.57-1.00). eGFR 45 mL/min/1.73m2. Urine albumin-creatinine ratio 92 mg/g. Haemoglobin 12.1 g/dL. TSH 2.1 µIU/mL (ref 0.4-4.5).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
telmisartan 40 mg OD
 dapagliflozin 10 mg OD
 furosemide increased to 40 mg OD
 sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD
 salbutamol MDI SOS
 budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD
 montelukast 10 mg HS
 melatonin 3 mg HS
 trazodone 50 mg HS
 add: ferrous sulfate 325 mg OD for mild anemia

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Pulmonology, Dr S. Reddy, for uncontrolled asthma symptoms and increased rescue inhaler use. Request spirometry review and asthma action plan.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonology review: Asthma remains moderate; budesonide-formoterol continued, add tiotropium inhaler 2.5 µg OD. Action plan provided. No changes to CKD meds.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for follow‑up with Dr Kulkarni on 2025-10-05 at 10:30 am. (Booked 2025-09-05).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports improved breathing after adding tiotropium; still mild fatigue.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5, stable.
falls: No falls; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline) – continue strength exercises.
medicines: 10 regular (includes ferrous sulfate) – polypharmacy, Beers review pending.
mood: Mood improved, denies depression.
carers: Daughter, Priya (primary caregiver).
goals: "I want to maintain my independence and keep my kidney numbers steady."
